item: Existing NBA evidence uses 2025-26 data while 2026-27 is in progress
detail: nba-2026-lab/ and research/nba-2026/ are built on the 2025-26 season. Official nba.com standings and player logs show 2026-27 games from 21 Oct 2026. The existing sample is therefore not current; this desk uses 2026-27 official data and does not overwrite the older work.

item: README does not link the nba-2026-lab/ dashboard
detail: Text search of README.md (2026-11-03) finds no reference to nba-2026-lab/. README links only the docs/ NBA lab and the root NFL desk. Root navigation is CI-locked by another session and was not edited; this desk is linked from README only.

item: Existing NBA note says there is no route to stats.nba.com
detail: research/nba/correlations.md states the sandbox 'has no network route to stats.nba.com'. In this session nba.com stats HTML pages loaded (S02, S03, S04, S08). The stats.nba.com JSON endpoint returned errors from this sandbox, so the note is partly right and partly outdated and should be reviewed.

item: Existing qualitative correlation directions cite betting-guide websites
detail: research/nba/correlations.md and strategies.md cite nba-prop-bets.com, oddsindex.com and edgebetting.ai for correlation directions. These are not official sources. The directions are not re-verified here and no numeric value from them is used.

item: Edwards has 4 official 2026-27 game rows while Minnesota has 8 games
detail: nba.com shows Anthony Edwards in 4 official 2026-27 game rows (21-26 Oct 2026) and a 4-game header average (33.3 PPG). Minnesota's official record is 5-3 over 8 games. The sources reviewed do not state why Edwards is absent from the other 4 games. The reason is not inferred; availability should be checked on the official injury report and the team pages.

item: Reported NBA restrictions on player-prop combinations for 2026-27 are not confirmed on an official page
detail: Press reports (16-18 Oct 2026) describe an NBA memo to sportsbook partners that bars same-player under parlays, first-of markets (opening tip, first basket, a specific shot), unders for players expected to play under 12 minutes, and alternate under lines. The memo text was not found on an official NBA page in this session. Strategies C-03 to C-05 are marked UNVERIFIED and are blocked only if the memo is confirmed.

item: No official source publishes NBA prices in a verifiable form
detail: The nba.com games page text (S05) contains scores, schedule and records but no spreads, totals, moneylines or prop prices. No sportsbook price snapshots with timestamps were available from official sources. All price, closing-line, CLV, hit-rate and ROI cells are therefore blank.

item: Season-to-date sample is too small for validation
detail: Teams have 5 to 8 games (30 teams). A correlation from 30 teams has a 95% CI about +/-0.36 around r = 0. A 55% edge needs 783 priced bets to detect at 80% power (alpha 0.05, two-sided). No signal can be validated on this sample.

item: Official injury reports are linked but not parsed
detail: official.nba.com lists 2026-27 report PDFs (S06). The PDF files are on a host this sandbox cannot reach, so no injury variables were used.

Running nba-2026-lab/compute.py on its 10-row Edwards CSV reproduces its published coefficients (PTS x AST -0.0239; PTS x REB +0.5762; 3PM x PTS +0.7974; PTS x W +0.2925; AST x REB +0.2053). All 10 rows match the official S04 log cell by cell.

item: Branch naming differs from the brief
detail: The brief asks for branches named session-<id>/<task>. The platform requires this session to work on arena/9cf7de11-own5, so each task is recorded as an ID on that single branch in COORDINATION.md.

item: Date of NBA responsible-gaming release not visible in fetched text
detail: pr.nba.com/nba-wnba-responsible-gaming-campaign was fetched; its date does not appear in the text. The search index shows 2026-10-13. Only the campaign content is used.

item: Standard -110 price used only as arithmetic
detail: The break-even probability for -110 (52.38%) is computed from the American-odds formula. No book price was verified, so this is a convention, not a market value.

Standings W-L equal team-stats W-L for all 30 teams. League wins equal losses (107 each). Shooting percentages match makes/attempts within rounding. The league margin identity (sum of games x per-game +/-) holds within rounding. See tests/test_nba_line_desk.py.

item: 2025-26 standings retrieved via a URL parameter
detail: The 2025-26 standings were retrieved with the Season parameter on the same official page (S08). Every team has W+L = 82, which confirms a full regular season.

item: SIG03 reclassified as outcome-derived after the first run
detail: SIG03 (implied opponent points) = PTS minus (+/-). The margin is the outcome, so SIG03 is outcome-derived. It was first listed as a candidate, and after the first run showed r = -0.75 it was reclassified. It stays in the k = 8 count and is excluded from validation. The change is disclosed here rather than hidden.

item: Same-season box-score correlations are descriptive only
detail: PTS (r = 0.51, permutation p = 0.005) and TOV (r = -0.54, p = 0.003) pass the corrected statistical test, but they are measured in the same games as the 2026-27 win%. They describe how games were won and cannot predict results. Not used as signals.

item: Prior-season win% predicts 2026-27 win% statistically but cannot be validated
detail: 2025-26 final win% vs 2026-27 win%: r = 0.50 (95% CI 0.17 to 0.73, n = 30, permutation p = 0.005) passes alpha 0.025. It is not validated: teams have 5 to 8 games (20 required) and no priced market data exists (G2 to G5). The market may already price this relationship; that cannot be tested here.

item: Last-10 win% equals season win% in this sample
detail: Every team has 8 or fewer games, so the last-10 record covers the whole season. Its r = 1.00 with win% is mechanical. SIG12 is excluded.
